newsitem.title: USA: Northwest June systemwide load factor off.
newsitem.headline: Northwest June systemwide load factor off.

text.p: Northwest Airlines Inc said Tuesday it systemwide passenger load factor in June fell 1.3 points to 78.2 percent from the same month a year ago.
June 1997 traffic rose one percent from June 1996 to 6.50 billion revenue passenger miles while available seat miles increased 2.7 percent from a year ago to 8.31 billion.
Cargo ton miles in June 1997 were down 3.8 percent to 190.8 million.
Northwest attributed the decline in its June systemwide load factor to a previously reported softness in Japanese travel.

For the first half of 1997, Northwest's systemwide load factor rose 0.9 points to 73.5 percent. Traffic increased 4.8 percent over the same period of 1996 to 34.73 billion revenue passenger miles while available seat miles were up 3.6 percent from a year ago to 47.28 billion.
Cargo ton miles for the first six months of 1997 were up 0.4 percent from last year to 1.05 billion cargo ton miles.
Shares of Northwest were trading up 1/8 to 36-5/8.
